D: A young linguist joins a 1914 expedition to find the lost city of Atlantis.
P: Serve the mains when Cookie dishes up dinner around the campfire.
S: Cookie, the expedition's crusty old chuck wagon cook
Navy beans simmered slowly with bacon, onion, molasses and mustard for an hour until thick and smoky, served in tin cups.
the glowing blue crystals the Atlanteans wear

Blue jelly made with lemonade instead of water so it fizzes, set in shot glasses for 3 hours. Soak 4 gold-strength gelatine leaves in cold water for 5 minutes. Warm 150ml lemonade with 2 tbsp caster sugar, squeeze out the gelatine and stir in until dissolved. Add 350ml cold lemonade, a squeeze of lime and 2 drops blue food colouring. Pour into 8 shot glasses and chill 3 hours. Top each with a few blueberries and a pinch of popping candy just before serving so they crackle.
the giant submarine Ulysses heading into the deep
Crackers, cubes of cheddar, sliced salami and pickled onions packed into small tins like rations.
M: Cookie feeding the crew in the caverns

Beef chuck browned and simmered 3 hours with kidney beans, chilli, cumin and tomato until thick, served with cornbread from a cast iron pan. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Fry 2 onions and 4 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tsp chilli powder. Return the beef with 2 tins crushed tomatoes and 250ml beef stock and simmer covered for 2.5 hours. Add 2 drained tins kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Mix 150g cornmeal, 150g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 1 egg, 250ml buttermilk and 60g melted butter and bake in a hot cast iron pan at 220C for 20 minutes.
Kida and the Atlanteans welcoming the explorers
White fish grilled with lime and garlic, served with a mango and chilli salsa and coconut rice.
W: Meringue baked at 120C for 90 minutes and cooled in the oven, topped with whipped cream, blueberries and passionfruit.
K: Cookie keeping the crew going through the caverns

Strong brewed coffee poured over sweetened condensed milk and plenty of ice, stirred until creamy and caramel coloured, served in tin mugs. Brew 500ml strong coffee in a plunger or stovetop pot and let it cool for 10 minutes. Spoon 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk into each of 4 tin mugs or glasses. Fill with ice and pour the coffee over. Stir well until creamy. Add a pinch of cinnamon on top if you like.

s.note: Cookie, the expedition's crusty old chuck wagon cook
s.how: Soak 400g navy beans overnight and simmer until tender. Fry 150g diced bacon with a chopped onion, then stir in the beans, 3 tbsp molasses, a spoon of Dijon and enough water to cover. Simmer an hour until thick and smoky. Serve in tin cups.

s.note: the giant submarine Ulysses heading into the deep
s.how: Cut 200g cheddar into cubes and slice 150g salami. Pack small tins with water crackers, the cheese, salami and a few pickled onions. Close the lids and hand them out to the crew like rations on a long voyage to the bottom of the sea.

m.note: Kida and the Atlanteans welcoming the explorers
m.how: Rub 4 white fish fillets with lime juice, crushed garlic and salt and grill until just cooked. Dice a mango with chilli, red onion and lime for salsa. Cook jasmine rice in coconut milk with a pinch of salt. Serve the fish on the rice with the salsa.

w.how: Whisk 4 egg whites to stiff peaks, then add 220g caster sugar a spoon at a time until glossy. Shape into a round and bake at 120C for 90 minutes, then cool in the oven. Top with whipped cream, blueberries and passionfruit pulp.

d.note: Cookie keeping the crew going through the caverns
d.how: Brew 500ml strong coffee in a plunger or stovetop pot and let it cool for 10 minutes. Spoon 2 tbsp sweetened condensed milk into each of 4 tin mugs or glasses. Fill with ice and pour the coffee over. Stir well until creamy. Add a pinch of cinnamon on top if you like.
